subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): scope memory_recall and memory_forget in a shared store

question: Should memory-lancedb ship caller-selected scope partitions now, despite requiring doctor migration for every existing table and excluding scoped rows from automatic recall?
rationale: The code can implement either direction safely, but repository evidence cannot determine whether the permanent user contract should be an explicit manual partition primitive or a context-bound automatic memory feature.

options.title: Approve phase-one scopes
options.body: Land the documented explicit partition primitive and own the mandatory doctor step, explicit scoped recall, and non-authorization security model.

options.title: Wait for context binding
options.body: Pause this PR until a trusted active-scope signal and scope-aware automatic recall can ship as one coherent user contract.

recommendation.title: Approve phase-one scopes
recommendation.body: Land the documented explicit partition primitive and own the mandatory doctor step, explicit scoped recall, and non-authorization security model.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-lancedb history and product-review activity make this the strongest available routing candidate for the contract decision.
